metadata.er-tech-spec:
title: looply · 类目管理（Collection）实体关系图 version: v1.3 · 2026-06-29 tables: - name: collection comment: 前台商品分组 note: is_system=TRUE 为系统级（All Products），不可删除/下架；不区分终端，title/subtitle/banner_url 按 PC+移动端两端分端 JSON 存储；价格筛选范围运行时按商品池动态生成，不入库 columns: - name: collection_id comment: 分组ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: title comment: 前台标题(分端JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: subtitle comment: 页面副标题(分端JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: url_slug comment: URL路径段(不分端) constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_id comment: 市场（单选） constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: channel_id comment: 渠道（单选） constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: banner_url comment: Banner图URL(分端JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: banner_enabled comment: 是否展示Banner constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: description comment: 描述(富文本,SEO增强) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: seo_title comment: Meta Title constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: seo_description comment: Meta Desc constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: h1_title comment: 页面H1 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_type comment: 选品类型 rule/manual constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_config comment: 自动选品规则JSON constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: linked_brand_id comment: 关联品牌(品牌驱动Collection) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: default_sort_key comment: 默认排序(无manual项) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: visual_filter_enabled comment: 图文筛模块开关 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: quick_filter_enabled comment: 移动端快筛模块开关 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: products_per_page comment: PC每页商品数(移动端固定20/屏) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 draft/active/closed constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序权重 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_system comment: 是否系统级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_manual_product comment: 手动选品关联 note: UNIQUE(collection_id, listing_id)；商品下架后保留记录，is_hidden 可临时隐藏；pinned 标记固定位置 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: collection_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing_id comment: 商品listingID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 位置（Position） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: pinned comment: 是否固定位置 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_hidden comment: 是否隐藏 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 添加时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_hidden_product comment: 自动选品排除记录 note: UNIQUE(collection_id, listing_id)；自动选品下用于排除单个商品 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: collection_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing_id comment: 被排除的listingID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 排除时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_auto_pin comment: 自动选品Pin位置 note: UNIQUE(collection_id, listing_id)；自动选品支持固定位置，商品下架移出时同步清除pin记录 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: collection_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing_id comment: 被固定的listingID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: position comment: 固定位置 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 固定时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: filter_dimension comment: 筛选维度（全局池） note: source_type=attribute 时经 filter_dimension_source 关联属性；展示样式按图文筛/快筛/通用筛三模块分别配置；枚举值排序=策略+固定位置，打平态(value_pins)与分组态(value_order_grouped)两套独立存储 columns: - name: dimension_id comment: 维度ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_name comment: 维度名称(EN,全局唯一) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_type comment: 数据源 attribute/brand/series/price/condition/backend_category/tag constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_config comment: 数据源配置JSON（类目各级展示名等） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_type_visual comment: 图文筛展示样式 card/color constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_type_quick comment: 快筛展示样式 card/panel/slider/color/tree constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_type_common comment: 通用筛展示样式 card/panel/slider/color/tree constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_strategy comment: 排序策略 source/numeric/alpha/count_desc constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: value_pins comment: 打平态固定位JSON{值key:位置} constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: value_order_grouped comment: 分组态固定位JSON(按属性值全局位次,尺码按体系) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: scope_grouped comment: 仅attribute:是否按作用域分组(默认FALSE) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: category_pins comment: 仅backend_category:类目顺序Pin记录JSON constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 通用筛选器全局展示顺序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/inactive constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: filter_dimension_source comment: 维度-属性多源绑定 note: UNIQUE(dimension_id, attribute_id)；仅 source_type=attribute 的维度使用 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_id comment: 所属筛选维度 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: attribute_id comment: 关联属性定义ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 多源优先级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_quick_filter comment: 移动端快筛项配置 note: UNIQUE(collection_id, dimension_id)；快筛每项引用一个筛选维度；仅移动端、无适用终端字段；模块总开关在 collection.quick_filter_enabled columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: collection_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_id comment: 引用的筛选维度 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 从左到右顺序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否展示 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_visual_filter comment: 图文筛项配置 note: 每项=展示文案+适用终端+图片+一组筛选项(filter_condition)；devices至少一端;image_enable选项级图片开关,split_image多端时可分端配图;维度间AND、同维度多值OR,不支持OR组合/嵌套;无系统级All项 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: collection_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: label_text comment: 展示文案 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: devices comment: 适用终端(PC/移动端,至少一端) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: image_enable comment: 是否展示图片(选项级) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: split_image comment: 是否分开配图(多端时) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: image_url comment: 图片URL(单图,split_image=F) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: image_url_pc comment: PC图片URL(split_image=T) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: image_url_mobile comment: 移动端图片URL(split_image=T) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: filter_condition comment: 筛选项JSON（维度AND·同维度多值OR） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/inactive constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_sort_config comment: Collection排序项配置 note: UNIQUE(collection_id, sort_key)；决定本 Collection 展示哪些排序项(recommended/newest/price↑↓)、顺序及默认项；v0.14 起移除 manual 项,固定位置由 Pin 承载 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: collection_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_key comment: 排序项key constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 展示顺序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_default comment: 是否默认排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/inactive constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing comment: 商品上架记录 note: 外部引用，字段由商品系统维护，不在本模块展开 columns: - name: listing_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: attribute_def comment: 属性定义 note: 外部引用，字段由商品系统维护，不在本模块展开 columns: - name: attribute_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: brand comment: 品牌 note: filter_dimension source_type=brand 时的数据来源；亦被 collection.linked_brand_id 引用(品牌驱动 Collection)（逻辑引用） columns: - name: brand_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: series comment: 系列 note: filter_dimension source_type=series 时的数据来源（逻辑引用） columns: - name: series_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market comment: 市场 note: collection.market_id 引用，控制商品池范围（逻辑引用） columns: - name: market_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: channel comment: 渠道 note: collection.channel_id 引用，读商品中心渠道管理（逻辑引用） columns: - name: channel_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: backend_category comment: 后台类目 note: 既作为 filter_dimension 数据源(source_type=backend_category)，也用于 rule_config 条件字段（均为逻辑引用，非FK） columns: - name: category_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: tag comment: 标签 note: filter_dimension source_type=tag 时的数据来源；仅取适用对象=渠道商品/通用且启用的标签（逻辑引用） columns: - name: tag_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: collection to: fc_manual_product type: 1:N label: 手动选品 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.8 - from: collection to: fc_hidden_product type: 1:N label: 排除记录 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: collection to: fc_auto_pin type: 1:N label: 自动选品Pin color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: collection to: fc_quick_filter type: 1:N label: 快筛配置 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: collection to: fc_visual_filter type: 1:N label: 图文筛配置 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: collection to: fc_sort_config type: 1:N label: 排序配置 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: filter_dimension to: fc_quick_filter type: 1:N label: 被快筛引用 color: '#2E7D4F' penwidth: 1.4 - from: filter_dimension to: fc_visual_filter type: '' label: 'filter_condition 引用
（JSON，非FK）' color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: filter_dimension to: filter_dimension_source type: 1:N label: 多源绑定 color: '#2E7D4F' penwidth: 1.4 - from: listing to: fc_manual_product type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: listing to: fc_hidden_product type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: listing to: fc_auto_pin type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: attribute_def to: filter_dimension_source type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: brand to: filter_dimension type: '' label: source_type=brand color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: series to: filter_dimension type: '' label: source_type=series color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: backend_category to: filter_dimension type: '' label: source_type=backend_category color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: tag to: filter_dimension type: '' label: source_type=tag color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: brand to: collection type: '' label: 'linked_brand_id
（品牌驱动Collection）' color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: backend_category to: collection type: '' label: 'rule_config 条件字段
（JSON引用，非FK）' color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: market to: collection type: '' label: market_id color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: channel to: collection type: '' label: channel_id color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed design_rules: R-01: Collection 无层级嵌套，扁平结构，导航层级由 Navigation 模块承载 R-02: 商品粒度为 listing 级别，不按 SPU 聚合 R-03: 自动选品/手动选品两种模式互斥（source_type=rule 或 manual） R-04: All Products 为系统级 Collection（is_system=TRUE），不可删除、不可下架、rule_config 为空（全量） R-05: 自动选品支持固定位置（fc_auto_pin）；商品因下架移出 Collection 时同步清除对应 pin 记录 R-06: 手动选品商品下架后 fc_manual_product 记录保留，is_hidden=TRUE，商品重新上架后恢复 R-07: backend_category 既可作为 filter_dimension 的 source_type，也用于 rule_config 条件字段 R-08: filter_dimension source_type=attribute 时，通过 filter_dimension_source 支持多个 attribute_def 绑定到同一维度（尺码亦走 attribute） R-09: Collection 不区分终端：title/subtitle/banner_url 按 PC+移动端两端分端 JSON 存储；商品来源/市场/渠道/URL/Meta/排序/通用筛选器不分端 R-10: 图文筛每条选项用 devices(适用终端,至少一端)控制 PC/移动端展示;image_enable 选项级图片开关,split_image 多端时分端配图;快筛为移动端专属、无 device 字段 R-11: 某维度在当前商品池(全集∩图文筛∩搜索词)内有≥2个不同值时才展示，否则前端物理隐藏；count=0 的候选值不返回 R-12: 展示样式 5 种(card/panel/slider/color/tree)，按图文筛/快筛/通用筛三模块分别配置(display_type_*)；可选样式=数据源允许∩模块支持。数据源可用样式：brand/series/condition/tag=card/panel，price=slider，backend_category=tree(固定)，attribute=card/panel(+color仅color_family,+tree仅开启作用域分组) R-13: 分组(tree)返回「分组标题+值列表」两层结构：类目=一级标题(不可勾)+三级值(可勾)、作用域分组=「类目名·品牌名·系列名」标题+组内值；类目与作用域分组结构等价，前端同一套组件渲染 R-14: 价格筛选范围运行时按各 Collection 商品池动态生成（min=$0，max=最高价向上取整到百位），不入库 R-15: 通用筛选器零配置：按当前商品池从全局维度池(status=active)动态匹配，无 Collection 级配置表 R-16: 枚举值排序=策略(sort_strategy)+固定位置;打平态用 value_pins,分组态(scope_grouped=TRUE)固定数据源默认序+value_order_grouped(按属性值全局位次,尺码按体系),两套独立存储 R-17: 快筛与通用筛选器可选项互不影响、互不缩减(避免越筛越少)；但共享同一筛选状态、双向同步选中态；已选保留，仅图文筛切换/新搜索词/用户主动移除时清空 R-18: backend_category 维度固定三级、全量纳入、无需勾选;一级类目仅作分组标题不可勾,用户只勾三级;顺序按 category_pins(Pin区)+跟随区(商品侧sort_order)合并 R-19: 品牌驱动 Collection:collection.linked_brand_id 非空即标识,rule_config 为 brand 条件;SEO 降级实时读品牌管理 R-20: 商品列表分端加载:移动端无限流(20/屏,全集滑完接 For You 推荐区,复用主页推荐);PC 传统翻页(products_per_page),不接推荐区 R-21: 筛选名称多语言:分组标题/节点展示名按当前语言取,优先级 运营展示名(注册翻译key)>翻译模块>fallback;品牌/系列有英文专名列,类目仅单列靠翻译模块/运营展示名补;后端按语言拼好下发,前端不拼不译
